messages:
Tess: Heads-up team — planning a targeted sweep for EU accounts tomorrow 08:00 CET. Problem: onboarding_status is 'in_progress' for many customers who have had zero activity for >45 days, which is triggering auto-onboard playbooks and flooding owners. Goal: set canonical onboarding_status = 'stalled' for these, add tag 'stalled_onboard:2026-03-24', and suppress non-critical playbooks for affected owners while we run. Dry-run first 150 accounts. ETA ~40m.
Ethan: Important: do NOT touch manual_onboard_flag or accounts with active_pilot = true. Also skip accounts where gdpr_dedup_lock = true.
Tess: Agreed. Dry-run query below (preview only):
```sql
-- find EU accounts with in_progress but no activity in 45+ days
SELECT account_id, owner_id, onboarding_status, last_activity_at, region
FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_status = 'in_progress'
  AND region IN ('EU')
  AND (last_activity_at IS NULL OR last_activity_at < now() - INTERVAL '45 days')
  AND manual_onboard_flag IS NULL
  AND active_pilot = false
LIMIT 150;
```
Rox: How will suppression work? We only want to mute onboarding nudges, not billing or security runbooks.
Tess: We'll set a temporary owner-scoped flag: `playbook_quiet=onboard_nudges` read by the runner. Critical runbooks bypass that flag. We'll enable for affected owners 07:55-09:00 CET.
proc-bot: Task scheduled: CS-9977 "EU stalled onboard sweep + owner-scoped quiet" created by Tess. Dry-run id dr-3111234567.
Ethan: Rollback plan? If we mislabel, need fast revert.
Tess: We'll snapshot affected rows to cs_admin.backups.stalled_onboard_3111234567 before any writes. Revert via backup table and upload changed_ids csv to admin-s3/stalled_onboard/3111234567.csv. We'll also log a git patch of the small migration SQL to cs-admin/logs/3111234567.patch.
Rox: Monitoring: watch playbook_fires/min (onboard_nudge), webhook_queue, and support tickets tagged 'onboard_issue'. If >30 changes/min or >3x webhook spike, rollback.
Ethan: Small nit: ensure we add trace tag 'stalled_onboard:3111234567' (timestamped) so owners can filter. Also do not overwrite onboarding_status when manual_onboard_flag IS NOT NULL.
Tess: Done. Plan: dry-run 08:00-08:05 CET, owner batches 08:05-08:45, verification 08:45-09:00. I will post start/finish counts. :white_check_mark:
Rox: lgtm. I'll stand by to flip rollback if metrics look off.
Tess: Kicking off dry-run in ~10m; will paste sample output when ready.
